title: Lazy's Corrupted Katarin (STAGES + RESKINS)
author: LazyIcarus
description:
Gameplay progressive corruption and ascension of Katarin. Each stage mod is standalone and you don't need to have all of them loaded. If you don't have this progression framework, each stage mod will just be a graphical reskin, but with this mod they will also bring significant gameplay changes.

Join discord: <https://discord.gg/W4qkrNwUMk>

Wiki: <https://lewdhammer.miraheze.org/wiki/Lewdhammer_Wiki>

Need the framework (!!li_progression_framework.pack - name may change, see the download file content list for latest details) from here for the stages (ignore if you only want the reskins):

File contents:

You can use the reskins by themselves, and also in combination with the progression system. All have been reuploaded to steam to allow easier updates! The downloads just redirects you to the steam collection.
